expo.reason: Expo 58.0.14 retains the reviewed React Native 0.88.0 bootstrap and iOS scene sources while updating bundled module recommendations. Runtime 1.8.27 coordinates its exact CLI, Babel preset, modules core, dev launcher and application dependencies. Preserve native lifecycle and consent guards; validate regenerated Android and iOS projects and native startup before release.

@sentry/react-native.reason: Sentry 8.31.0 updates Android SDK 8.60.0 to 8.61.0, Cocoa SDK 9.30.1 to 9.30.2 and JavaScript SDK 10.76.0 to 10.76.2. Runtime 1.8.26 regenerates native projects and the iOS symbol-upload phase while preserving crash mirroring, consent, disabled profiling/replay and symbol uploads; validate native builds and startup.

react-native-gesture-handler.reason: Gesture Handler 3.4.0 advances the native gesture implementation while retaining the app's Pan, Pinch, Tap and composed gesture API. Expo 58.0.14 bundles 3.3.0; validate Android and iOS native builds plus watch-screen drag and screenshot-lightbox gestures in runtime 1.8.27.

react-native-safe-area-context.reason: Safe-area 5.10.1 preserves the 5.10.0 Android/iOS implementation and fixes SwiftPM package metadata; validate its integration in runtime 1.8.14.

react-native-web.reason: React Native Web 0.21.4 adds public AssetRegistry entry points shared by CJS and ESM. Expo CLI 58.1.11 retains the reviewed legacy registry fallback through the public React Native and React Native Web registries; verify Pages and Hosting exports before delivery.

@babel/core.reason: Babel 8.0.7 compiles mocked TypeScript and JSX test fixtures. Expo and Worklets retain the separately pinned Babel 7 adapter because their transforms still require Babel 7 APIs.

typescript.reason: TypeScript 7 checks the app and crash-reporting workspace. ESLint uses the official TypeScript 6 compatibility package for its compiler API.

react-native-reanimated.reason: Reanimated 4.7.1 supports React Native 0.88 and Worklets 0.13 and adds native teardown and layout-animation crash fixes. Runtime 1.8.15 regenerates native projects, rebases the callback-cleanup patch and verifies the upstream native-state guard with lifecycle tests and Android/iOS builds.

react-native.reason: React Native 0.88.0 stable retains the reviewed rc.4 runtime and guarded choreographer/setup sources, with version metadata and AssetRegistry type updates. Pin its Metro config, JS polyfills and transitive packages together under runtime 1.8.24.

Preserve renderer checks and validate native launch/render behavior under runtime 1.8.26.
